name: ExaWizards Inc.
summary: ExaWizards Inc. is a Japanese company that builds artificial intelligence-driven services to support industrial progress and address societal challenges in Japan. It operates in two areas, AI Platform and AI Products. The AI Platform segment guides clients through each stage of AI adoption from understanding and strategy to design, while AI Products addresses common issues faced by industries and communities. Dating from 2016, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
